subject.title: Validate required run artifacts against a schema (`--require-artifact-schema`)

question: Should Crabbox core own validation of user-supplied artifact schemas, or should schema validity remain enforced by repository commands as currently documented?
rationale: This adds a new CLI/config contract and crosses an explicit documentation boundary, so the desired long-term product responsibility requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep validation repo-owned
options.body: Retain the existence-only Crabbox gate and document a reusable repository-command pattern for schema validation.

options.title: Adopt the core gate
options.body: Approve the bounded fail-closed CLI surface and require the linked PR to demonstrate real SSH-backed behavior before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep validation repo-owned
recommendation.body: Retain the existence-only Crabbox gate and document a reusable repository-command pattern for schema validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties steipete most strongly to artifact handling and central CLI product boundaries.
